SELECT m.movie_asin AS movie_asin, m.movie_title AS movie_title, m.score AS score, act.actors, dir.directors, gen.genres, concat(rd.year, '-', lpad(rd.month, 2, '0'), '-', lpad(rd.day, 2, '0')) AS release_date, edi.editions FROM (SELECT id, movie_asin, movie_title, score FROM movies WHERE id IN #{id} ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ma.movie_id, concat_ws(',', collect_set(a.name)) AS actors FROM movie_actors ma JOIN actors a ON ma.actor_id = a.id WHERE ma.movie_id IN #{id} GROUP BY ma.movie_id ) act ON m.id = act.movie_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT md.movie_id, concat_ws(',', collect_set(d.name)) AS directors FROM movie_directors md JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE md.movie_id IN #{id} GROUP BY md.movie_id ) dir ON m.id = dir.movie_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mg.movie_id, concat_ws(',', collect_set(mg.genre)) AS genres FROM movie_genres mg WHERE mg.movie_id IN #{id} GROUP BY mg.movie_id ) gen ON m.id = gen.movie_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rd.movie_id, year, month, day FROM release_dates rd WHERE rd.movie_id IN #{id} ) rd ON m.id = rd.movie_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT me.movie_id, concat_ws(',', collect_set(me.edition)) AS editions FROM movie_editions me WHERE me.movie_id IN #{id} GROUP BY me.movie_id ) edi ON m.id = edi.movie_id ORDER BY m.movie_title
